connectors.rawg.key.title: Get your RAWG key
connectors.rawg.key.body:
RAWG is free and only needs a key. It is used to show covers and details of your games.
Press “Open the page”: RAWG opens in a new tab. Create an account or sign in.
Request an API key (you can call the application “Ludiary”).
Copy the key they show you.
Come back to this tab and press “Paste”.
connectors.rawg.error.format: That key does not look right. It must have letters and numbers only, with no spaces or symbols.
connectors.igdb.key.title: Create your Twitch application for IGDB
connectors.igdb.key.body:
IGDB is free, but it asks you to create an application on Twitch. It takes a few minutes.
Press “Open the page”: Twitch opens in a new tab. Sign in with your Twitch account (it needs two-step verification turned on).
Type a unique name, set the OAuth redirect URL to http://localhost, pick any category and press “Create”.
In your list of applications, press “Manage” on the new one.
Copy the “Client ID” and paste it in the first field.
Press “New Secret”, copy the “Client Secret” and paste it in the second field.
connectors.igdb.error.format: One of the two values does not look right. They must have letters and numbers only, with no spaces.
